owkin.note: Owkin platform API key for pathology and histomics data

huggingface.note: HuggingFace Hub API token for paper/model/dataset search (optional, some endpoints work without auth)

google_drive.note: Google Drive OAuth2 credentials. Set GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN for simple auth, or set refresh_token + client_id + client_secret for auto-refresh.
